About the author

Roza Khorami Sabur is a Denmark-based writer whose work is centered around poetry, reflection, and the timeless depth of human emotion.
Her writing explores themes of hope, identity, resilience, longing, and inner strength through an elegant and thoughtful literary voice. With a style that blends simplicity with emotional depth, her work invites readers into moments of reflection, beauty, and quiet understanding.
Through carefully chosen words and atmospheric storytelling, Roza creates pieces that resonate with readers seeking meaning, emotion, and connection in a modern world.
